text:
Lina (Mktg): Need a compact launch visual kit for our inference economics webinar next week. Ask: 3 hero images (1200x628, 800x800, 1920x1080), two process diagrams (routing + graceful fallback), a 1-page SDR crib sheet, and a short 15-20s animated fallback slide. First-pass Tue AM please.

Omar (Design): Got it. I have Tue morning blocked. Drop exact headline, stat, and any micro-copy for diagram callouts.

Bea (PMM): Headline: "Predictable inference economics: latency you can budget for." Stat (use as a callout): "~2.3x cost reduction vs naive serving with batching + KV cache (internal benchmark)". CTA: "Configuration guide + live demo".

Theo (Webinar): Diagrams should be swimlane so we can animate the fallback. Sparkline needs three labeled callouts: baseline, batched+cache, dedicated. We also want hover tooltip text for each point.

Omar (Design): Tooltip lines (<=8 words) please. Also confirm routing lane labels.

Lina (Mktg): Tooltips: Baseline: "single-request, no batching — higher unit cost"; Batched+cache: "workload-aware batching + KV cache — lower cost"; Dedicated: "reserved capacity — predictable latency & throughput". Routing lanes: "ingest → policy router → model pool → fallback".

Rae (Legal): Legal flag: include this exact footnote on any stat or chart: "Internal benchmark on representative test workload; actual results vary by model and traffic patterns." Also add a short data statement on the PDF footer: "No customer data used in benchmarks." I can sign off once added.

Omar (Design): Plan: PNG placeholders Tue 9:30AM, Figma frames + motion spec Tue 4PM. I'll push assets to Figma (/marketing/inference-kit) and tag @Lina @Theo @Bea. Motion spec: fade+slide, 18s total, 2s pause on final.

AssetBot: Comment added on /marketing/inference-kit/diagrams/seq1: "need exact routing labels for swimlane lanes"

Bea (PMM): I'll add the SDR crib (3 bullets + routing one-liner + demo link) to Figma comments and include a link to the benchmark appendix.

Lina (Mktg): Owners: Omar (design), Bea (copy + crib), Rae (legal). If assets are in by Tue PM we can lock for Wed publish. Thanks! :rocket:
